title: AI-Portfolio
tagline: An AI-powered interactive portfolio website with 3D animations and a built-in intelligent assistant.
description: Personal AI-powered portfolio website with interactive 3D elements and intelligent features.
longDescription: Interactive personal developer portfolio designed to present projects, skills, experience and developer identity through a modern animated interface.
problemStatement: Traditional portfolios can feel static and fail to demonstrate frontend engineering, animation, 3D and interactive capabilities.
keyFeatures: Floating AI-style portfolio assistant with local response engine
myRole: Frontend developer and full-stack developer, designed and implemented the portfolio architecture, UI, interactions, animations, 3D experience and deployment workflow.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Creating a highly interactive UI without sacrificing responsiveness
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved through component-based architecture, lazy loading and optimized rendering.
Solved by separating visual systems into reusable components.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Maintaining accessibility and responsive behavior across devices
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved through responsive Tailwind layouts and accessibility patterns.

resultsAndImpact: Created a polished interactive portfolio that demonstrates modern React, TypeScript, animation, 3D and frontend engineering capabilities.
architecture: React application → layouts and pages → reusable sections/components → hooks/utilities/local AI engine → Vite build → GitHub Pages deployment with GitHub Actions

title: AI-WildEye
tagline: AI-driven early-warning system for detecting human-wildlife conflicts in real-time.
description: Web-Based Wild Animal Detection and Alert System - College Main Project.
longDescription: AI-based wildlife image recognition application combining Django with computer vision and TensorFlow-based machine learning.
problemStatement: Wildlife identification from images can be difficult and time-consuming, creating an opportunity to assist recognition using computer vision and machine learning.
myRole: Full-stack machine-learning developer responsible for the Django application, image-processing pipeline, ML experimentation, model integration and frontend/backend workflow.

challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using OpenCV and Pillow preprocessing.
Solved through TensorFlow-based training and evaluation workflows.
Solved through structured preprocessing and ML pipeline separation.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Connecting ML inference with a web application
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved by separating Django application logic from the ML processing layer.

resultsAndImpact: Built an end-to-end educational computer-vision application demonstrating practical image processing, TensorFlow-based recognition and web integration.
architecture: User image → Django application → OpenCV/Pillow preprocessing → TensorFlow ML model → wildlife prediction → application response

title: No-Due Submission Portal
tagline: Digital platform streamlining student no-due clearance with automated workflows.
description: College Mini Project - A web-based platform for student no-due clearance.
longDescription: Role-based college no-due clearance platform that digitizes a multi-department student clearance process.
problemStatement: Manual no-due clearance involves multiple departments, paper/document submissions, repeated verification and sequential approvals, creating delays and tracking difficulties.
myRole: Full-stack developer responsible for frontend, backend API, authentication, workflow architecture, role-based permissions, routing logic, file validation, database integration and certificate generation.

challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved through explicit section-based state transitions.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Routing requests to the correct verifier
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using department/division/semester/verifier-type rules.
Solved through extension/content-type validation, size limits and section-specific upload rules.
Solved using approval/rejection remarks and timestamps with audit history.
Solved through JWT authentication and RBAC.

resultsAndImpact: Digitized and centralized the college clearance workflow, reducing manual coordination and providing students and staff with transparent status tracking and structured verification.
architecture: React/Vite frontend → Django REST API → authentication/accounts → submissions/verification modules → workflow and routing engine → SQLite database → document uploads → clearance status/certificate generation

title: AI-BrestCancer Predictor
description: Breast cancer histopathology image classification as Benign or Malignant.
longDescription:
Full-stack research and educational application for classifying breast histopathology image patches as Benign or Malignant using a CancerNet CNN model.

Note: Research and educational project, not a medical device.
problemStatement: Histopathology image classification is complex and can benefit from deep-learning-based image analysis for research and educational exploration.
myRole: Full-stack machine-learning developer responsible for the React interface, Django REST API, image-processing workflow, CNN integration, prediction persistence, authentication and performance dashboard.

challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using TensorFlow/Keras CancerNet CNN architecture.
Solved using Django/Pillow-based processing.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Connecting deep-learning inference to a web API
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using Django REST endpoints.
Solved through PostgreSQL-backed prediction history.
Solved through dashboard metrics and training-history visualizations.

resultsAndImpact: Created an interactive end-to-end deep-learning application demonstrating image classification, model inference, confidence scoring, history tracking and ML performance visualization.
architecture: React/Vite frontend → Django REST API → image upload/preprocessing → TensorFlow/Keras CancerNet CNN → prediction/confidence → PostgreSQL prediction history → performance dashboard

title: AI-Job Portal
tagline: Full-featured Django recruitment platform with intelligent job matching.
description: Django-based recruitment portal with authentication and job management.
longDescription: AI-powered job marketplace connecting job seekers and recruiters through role-based dashboards, job management, applications, resume processing and intelligent recommendations.
problemStatement: Traditional job platforms require users and recruiters to manually search, evaluate and match candidates, creating inefficient recruitment workflows.
keyFeatures: Deterministic fallback matching when Gemini is unavailable
myRole: Full-stack AI developer responsible for frontend development, backend APIs, authentication, job and application workflows, resume processing, AI integration, database design and system architecture.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Designing different workflows for job seekers and recruiters
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using role-based authentication and dashboards.
Solved using PDF and DOC/DOCX parsing libraries.
Solved with Gemini integration and deterministic local fallback logic.
Solved by combining AI analysis with structured matching logic.

resultsAndImpact: Created an end-to-end AI recruitment platform that supports job discovery, candidate evaluation, resume analysis, recommendations and application management.
architecture: React/Vite frontend → Django REST API → accounts/jobs/applications/resume modules → AI analysis and matching services → Google Gemini → PostgreSQL

title: AI Insurance Predictor
description: ML-powered insurance purchase prediction with JWT authentication, prediction history and model comparison.
longDescription: Full-stack machine-learning application for predicting insurance purchase outcomes from customer age and estimated salary.
problemStatement: Insurance prediction requires evaluating multiple machine-learning algorithms and exposing predictions and model performance through an accessible application.
myRole: Full-stack developer and machine-learning developer, responsible for data processing, model training/evaluation, backend API development, frontend integration, database persistence and deployment.

challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved by evaluating Logistic Regression, KNN, SVM, Decision Tree and Random Forest using consistent metrics.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Integrating trained models into a web API
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using joblib model persistence and Django REST endpoints.
Solved with PostgreSQL-backed models.
Solved through Gunicorn, WhiteNoise and Render configuration.

resultsAndImpact: Delivered an end-to-end ML system connecting data processing, model evaluation, prediction API, user interface, persistence and cloud deployment.
architecture: React frontend → Django REST API → prediction service → trained scikit-learn models → joblib model files → PostgreSQL prediction history → Render deployment

title: Pachoos
tagline: Modern e-commerce platform with AI-powered product recommendations.
description: AI-E-Commerce platform with shopping cart and checkout.
longDescription: Production-oriented full-stack bakery and fruit ordering platform for managing customers, products, inventory, carts, orders, payments, wallets and business operations.
problemStatement: Local food businesses need a centralized digital platform to manage online ordering, inventory, customers, payments, delivery-related operations and administrative workflows.
myRole: Full-stack developer responsible for frontend architecture, backend APIs, database design, authentication, authorization, business logic, security, integrations, testing and deployment.

challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using AES-GCM encryption and masked last-four output.
Solved with structured RBAC and permission-aware APIs.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Preserving historical orders when customers are deleted
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using soft-delete patterns.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Managing frontend server and client state
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Handling background jobs and asynchronous operations
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Solved using Celery and Redis.
Solved with automated backend testing and frontend type checking.

resultsAndImpact: Built a functional production-oriented commerce platform with integrated ordering, business workflows, authentication, financial-data protection and administration.
196 backend tests passing and frontend type checking clean.
architecture: React/Vite frontend → REST API → Django/DRF backend → authentication/permissions/business services → PostgreSQL database, asynchronous tasks → Celery/Redis, external services → OpenAI/Firebase/Razorpay/Google Maps/cloud storage → Docker/Gunicorn/Nginx deployment
